answer: To spin up a sybil, an attacker must fund fresh bonds and farm genuine attestations across an entire grove of fake identities, paying real stake plus time on every reef of the graph. Each agent stakes a bond tied to a unique verified reputation slot, and reputation accrues through peer-attested work rather than self-claims. Colluding accounts get slashed when detected, so the marginal cost of one more dune of fabricated reputation exceeds any payout, making mass identity creation unprofitable. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
